news_items.headline: Susquehanna raises Marriott price target to $385 amid strong luxury performance
news_items.summary: Susquehanna lifted its PT to $385 citing strong luxury segment performance, though it flagged elevated valuations and a cautious near-term outlook.

news_items.headline: Marriott International stock closed up 3.28% on May 27
news_items.summary: MAR shares rose 3.28% on May 27, 2026, trading near the top of its 52-week range and above its 200-day SMA.

news_items.headline: Marriott cash dividend of $0.73 goes ex on May 22
news_items.summary: MAR's quarterly cash dividend of $0.73 per share had an ex-dividend date of May 22, 2026.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: 26 analysts rate MAR 'Buy'/'Moderate Buy', avg 12-month PT ~$377.67 (slightly below current price). In May 2026, Jefferies and Mizuho raised PTs after strong Q1 results, increased capital returns and an EBITDA beat; Susquehanna raised PT to $385 (2026-05-27).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 results already reported and beat on EBITDA (referenced in May analyst PT raises). 2026 catalyst: projected ~35% jump in co-branded credit card fees from renegotiated Chase/Amex royalty rates; 2026 guidance worldwide RevPAR +1.5-2.5%, net rooms +4.5-5%. No confirmed next earnings date surfaced; next report expected late July/early August 2026 (typical Q2 cadence) but unverified.
